subject: Romag
fact: Romag believes the Temple of Elemental Evil was founded on the principle that the true nature of the universe is constant chaos between the elements, with earth destined to reduce all things to dirt.
source_quote: He explained that the Temple of Elemental Evil was founded on the principle that the true nature of the universe is constant chaos between the elements, with earth destined to reduce all things to dirt.

subject: Romag
fact: Romag believes the temple attracted those who embraced the inevitability of elemental chaos rather than feared it, seeking to bring about the blessed moment when all would be reduced to a wasteland of earth.
source_quote: The temple attracted those who embraced this inevitability rather than feared it, seeking to bring about the blessed moment when all would be reduced to a wasteland of earth.

subject: Romag
fact: Romag revealed that ten years ago, the forces of the temple were defeated at the Battle of Emory Meadows by the Archbishop of Veluna and the Kingdom of Furyondy.
source_quote: Romag then revealed what had happened ten years ago. The forces of the temple had united and marched out to conquer, but they were defeated at the Battle of Emory Meadows by the Archbishop of Veluna and the Kingdom of Furyondy.

subject: Romag
fact: Romag knows the key to unlocking the temple's central power is an orb, the only object capable of forcing the chaotic elements to submit to the stability of earth.
source_quote: He revealed that the key was an orb, the only object capable of forcing the chaotic elements to submit to the stability of earth.

subject: Romag
fact: Romag believes the orb is the shackle that binds the storm and flood, the tool to impose the discipline of stone upon the reckless factions of fire and water.
source_quote: It was the shackle that binds the storm and flood, the tool to impose the discipline of stone upon the reckless factions of fire and water.

subject: The vault's contents
fact: The contents of the vault are unknown, as Romag did not yet trust the party enough to reveal them.
source_quote: When asked what was in the vault, Romag stated that such information needed to be earned—he did not yet trust them enough to reveal everything.

subject: Dick Rentsch
fact: Dick Rentsch wants disciplined, brutal soldiers loyal to gold, and is tired of relying on unreliable gnolls and unruly bugbears.
source_quote: Dick Rentsch had sent word of a group of professional mercenaries called the Broken Blades currently being recruited in Nulb. Romag was tired of relying on unreliable gnolls and unruly bugbears; he wanted disciplined, brutal soldiers loyal to gold.

subject: Dren Halveth
fact: Dren Halveth is a half-orc with broad shoulders, scars, and one ruined white eye, and leads the Broken Blades with a crew that hangs back relaxed but dangerous.
source_quote: Dren Halveth, a half-orc with broad shoulders, scars, and one ruined white eye. His crew hung back behind him, relaxed but dangerous, with fingers drifting near weapons.

subject: Dren Halveth
fact: Dren Halveth tasked the party with retrieving a shipment of weapons stolen by the Crimson Reapers, without bringing the wrath of the temple down on everyone.
source_quote: He tasked the party with retrieving the weapons without bringing the wrath of the temple down on everyone.

subject: Crimson Reaper
fact: A Crimson Reaper revealed that the chest of weapons was temple property that Dren had stolen, and gave him until midnight to join the temple or be killed.
source_quote: The Reaper explained that the chest was temple property that Dren had stolen. He stated that Dren had until midnight to join the temple or he and his crew would be dead.

subject: The deeper organization behind the elemental temples
fact: The Crimson Reapers work for a deeper organization behind the four elemental temples, not one of the four temples directly, but this organization's identity is not revealed.
source_quote: The party realized the Crimson Reapers worked for a deeper organization behind the four elemental temples, not one of the four temples directly.

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia argued that the Water Temple relied on propaganda and lies while the Earth Temple showed real commitment by coming to recruit the Broken Blades personally.
source_quote: Sequoia countered brilliantly, arguing that the Water Temple relied on propaganda and lies while the Earth Temple showed real commitment by coming to recruit them personally.

subject: Wat
fact: Wat, the barkeep, looked very unhappy about the Broken Blades joining the Earth Temple, confirming the party's suspicion that he worked for the Water Temple.
source_quote: Zinnia noticed that Wat, the barkeep, looked very unhappy about the outcome, confirming their suspicion that he worked for the Water Temple.

subject: Dick Rentsch
fact: Dick Rentsch said that until complete power was secured, everyone had to work together, justifying his continued payroll of Wat despite his apparent loyalty to the Water Temple.
source_quote: Dick responded that until they had secured complete power, everyone had to work together.

subject: Wat
fact: Wat approached Dren and whispered something to him, but Dren shoved him away.
source_quote: As they departed, Wat approached Dren and whispered something to him, but Dren shoved him away.

subject: Romag
fact: Romag proposed a toast to Sequoia, Zephyr, Zinnia, and Calmer for their contributions to increasing the Earth Temple's power, specifically highlighting Calmer's conversion from a cleric of St. Cuthbert to a follower of the elder elemental god.
source_quote: Romag proposed a toast to Sequoia, Zephyr, Zinnia, and Calmer for their contributions to increasing the Earth Temple's power, specifically highlighting Calmer's conversion from a cleric of St. Cuthbert to a follower of the elder elemental god.

subject: Romag
fact: Romag believes the orb is the key to the vault that opened the deep places within the temple.
source_quote: The orb was also the key to the vault that opened the deep places within the temple.

subject: The party
fact: The party chose to negotiate with the Crimson Reapers rather than steal the chest, sending Calmer to knock on their door.
source_quote: The party decided to try negotiating with the Crimson Reapers rather than stealing the chest. Calmer was sent to knock on their door while the rest of the party hid nearby.

subject: The party
fact: The party successfully brought the Broken Blades back to the temple after convincing Dren Halveth to join in exchange for one hundred gold pieces.
source_quote: Impressed by these arguments, Dren agreed to join the Earth Temple in exchange for one hundred gold pieces to help set up their new business.

subject: Romag
fact: Romag announced that the new territory would be given to the mercenaries, who would report to the party, though he claimed another portion of the cleared territory for himself.
source_quote: He announced that the new territory would be given to the mercenaries, who would report to the party, though he claimed another portion of the cleared territory for himself.

subject: The Earth Temple
fact: The Earth Temple is perceived by the Broken Blades as showing real commitment by personally recruiting them, contrasting with the Water Temple’s use of propaganda and lies.
source_quote: Sequoia countered brilliantly, arguing that the Water Temple relied on propaganda and lies while the Earth Temple showed real commitment by coming to recruit them personally.

subject: The identity of the deeper organization behind the elemental temples
fact: The deeper organization behind the elemental temples is unknown, and its goals, structure, and leadership are not revealed in this session.
source_quote: The party realized the Crimson Reapers worked for a deeper organization behind the four elemental temples, not one of the four temples directly.
